missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Ткань' stays in the nominative as the subject. This is a soft-sign feminine noun, and 'мягкая' is the agreeing feminine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Ткань' is the accusative direct object of 'купила'; soft-sign feminines look identical in nominative and accusative. 'Красивую' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Ткани' is the genitive required after 'нет' to express that no fabric is present. 'Белой' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Ткани' is the genitive after 'из' to show the material the dress is made of. 'Тонкой' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Тканью' is the instrumental case naming what the table is covered with. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine instrumental, and 'стол' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'На ткани' uses the prepositional form 'ткани' after 'на' to locate the pattern. 'Узор' is the nominative subject of the sentence.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Ткани' is the accusative plural object of 'продаёт'. 'Хорошие' agrees in the plural, and 'магазин' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Ткани' is the nominative plural subject of 'лежат'. 'Разные' agrees in the plural, and 'в шкафу' gives the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Genitive of quantity. 'Ткани' is the genitive after 'кусок' to mean a piece of fabric. 'Подруге' is the dative recipient of 'дала'.
Strategic focus: Nominative exclamation. 'Ткань' stays in the nominative in this exclamation. 'Какая' and 'красивая' both agree in the feminine, expressing admiration.
